canonical_transition.honest_flaw: This wake did not induce or prove an actually missing Slack message. It measured a false-missing condition caused by query specificity or indexing and recovered the existing projection through broader read surfaces. Slack search and channel history are not immutable or transactionally bound to Git. Git event and CURRENT are separate commits, so a crash can orphan an event or leave Git advanced without Slack. GitHub's file blob-SHA guard applies to one file only and does not provide cross-file atomicity, locks, linearizability, exactly-once execution, serializable transactions, database durability, Slack atomicity, or automatic repair.
canonical_transition.rollback: Never delete the immutable event or Slack message. If later invalidated, append a compensating event from the then-current version and replace CURRENT only with that pointer file's exact then-current blob SHA. Do not edit or duplicate the recovered v16 Slack projection.
